study type: Longitudinal discordant twin/sibling analysis within a cohort study
outcome: Offspring blood pressure (systolic blood pressure Z score)
cohort: The study included 193 twin pairs and 759 MVM-discordant sibling pairs from a longitudinal pregnancy cohort conducted from 1959 to 1965.
finding: High-grade placental maternal vascular malperfusion (MVM) was associated with higher offspring systolic blood pressure at age 7, with affected twins having a 0.56 SD higher systolic blood pressure Z score than their co-twin without MVM.
